en: Revenue reached a record $83.8M, up 67% from Q1 and 13 times a year ago, beating the ~$69M consensus by about 25%; same-portfolio growth was 85%. But the adjusted loss of $0.19 a share was wider than the ~$0.10 expected, and the operating loss was $163M including $106M of non-cash charges. CEO Eric Brock raised the 2026 revenue target to $525–550M and guided Q3 to $140–155M, with company-wide adjusted EBITDA profit targeted for Q4 2027.

Shares fell 9% on the day as the wider loss and acquisition-driven growth outweighed the revenue beat. The slide continued through August and September as Ondas announced more acquisitions paid partly in stock. Even $270M of new orders since June has not turned the trend; the stock is about 31% below its pre-report close.
zh: 营收创纪录达 8380 万美元，环比增长 67%，为一年前的 13 倍，较约 6900 万的预期高约 25%；同口径增长 85%。但调整后每股亏损 0.19 美元，大于约 0.10 的预期；营业亏损 1.63 亿美元，其中 1.06 亿为非现金费用。CEO 埃里克·布罗克将 2026 年营收目标上调至 5.25–5.5 亿美元，Q3 指引 1.4–1.55 亿，公司整体调整后 EBITDA 盈利目标定在 2027 年 Q4。
亏损扩大与收购驱动的增长盖过了营收超预期，股价当天下跌 9%。随着 Ondas 宣布更多部分以股票支付的收购，跌势延续至8、9月。即使6月以来获得 2.7 亿美元新订单，也未能扭转趋势；股价较财报前收盘价低约 31%。

bio.en: Chairman and CEO since 2018, with more than 20 years in global banking and investing before that. He has led Ondas's shift from industrial radios into drones and defense through a series of acquisitions, including Airobotics, Iron Drone and DZYNE.
bio.zh: 2018 年起任董事长兼 CEO，此前在全球银行与投资领域工作逾 20 年。他通过一系列收购（包括 Airobotics、Iron Drone 与 DZYNE），带领 Ondas 从工业无线电转向无人机与国防。

bio.en: CFO and treasurer since June 2024, a veteran finance executive. He has overseen the equity raises that built Ondas's cash pile to about $1.4B.
bio.zh: 2024 年6月起任 CFO 兼司库，为资深财务高管。主导多轮股权融资，令 Ondas 现金增至约 14 亿美元。
